name: talgent
description: Authoritative distribution of first-party Talgent Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: talgent
plugins.description: Talgent's core plugin for its Agents: the product context, the Standalone Work role and the Skills every Work acts through.

plugins.name: talgent-api
plugins.description: Talgent's public API for Agents that call it directly: publishing a Work's Artifacts and reading its owner's Personal Library.

plugins.name: talgent-orchestra
plugins.description: Talgent Orchestra's plugin for its Agents, beside the core plugin talgent: the Project context, one role per Project run mode (Work Agent, PM Coordinator, Alignment) and the project Skills they act through.
